content.json:
# OldWeb MCP experiment
External activity excludes requests carrying the private internal-test header. Caller groups are keyed IP/user-agent approximations, not verified identities or exact sessions. Client names are self-reported. Probe counts are aggregated; gaps and throttling must be considered before comparing phases.

content.title: Activity by service and phase
content.query: customEvents | where name == 'mcp_activity' | extend service=tostring(customDimensions.service), phase=tostring(customDimensions.phase), method=tostring(customDimensions.method), outcome=tostring(customDimensions.outcome), internal=tostring(customDimensions.internal) | where internal != 'true' | summarize Events=sum(todouble(customMeasurements.count)) by service, phase, method, outcome | order by service asc

content.title: Successful tool use and approximate repeat callers
content.query: customEvents | where name == 'mcp_activity' and tostring(customDimensions.internal) != 'true' and tostring(customDimensions.outcome) == 'tool_success' | extend service=tostring(customDimensions.service), caller=tostring(customDimensions.caller) | summarize Calls=count(), Days=dcount(bin(timestamp,1d)) by service, caller | summarize SuccessfulCalls=sum(Calls), CallerGroups=count(), ReturningThreeDays=countif(Days >= 3) by service

content.title: Tool outcomes and latency
content.query: customEvents | where name == 'mcp_activity' and tostring(customDimensions.internal) != 'true' and tostring(customDimensions.method) == 'tools/call' | extend service=tostring(customDimensions.service), tool=tostring(customDimensions.tool), outcome=tostring(customDimensions.outcome), ms=todouble(customMeasurements.durationMs) | summarize Calls=count(), Success=countif(outcome == 'tool_success'), ServiceErrors=countif(outcome == 'service_error'), ToolErrors=countif(outcome == 'tool_error'), p50=percentile(ms,50), p95=percentile(ms,95) by service, tool

content.title: Reported client identities at initialization only
content.query: customEvents | where name == 'mcp_activity' and tostring(customDimensions.internal) != 'true' and tostring(customDimensions.method) == 'initialize' | summarize Initializations=count() by Service=tostring(customDimensions.service), Client=tostring(customDimensions.clientName), Version=tostring(customDimensions.clientVersion), Outcome=tostring(customDimensions.outcome)

content.title: Telemetry gaps, throttling and probes
content.query: customEvents | where name == 'mcp_activity' and tostring(customDimensions.internal) != 'true' | where tostring(customDimensions.method) in ('probe','system') or tostring(customDimensions.outcome) in ('quota_exhausted','rate_limited','busy') | summarize Count=sum(todouble(customMeasurements.count)) by bin(timestamp,1h), Outcome=tostring(customDimensions.outcome)

content.title: Last reported month-to-date cost (USD; billing may lag)
content.query: customEvents | where name == 'mcp_cost' | summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by Period=tostring(customDimensions.period) | project timestamp, Period, CostUSD=todouble(customMeasurements.reportedCostUsd)

content.json:
## Cost and interpretation
Open Azure Cost Management filtered to resource group **rg-oldweb-mcp-experiment** for billing totals. The six-hour cost-guard workflow records reported month-to-date cost and pauses ingress at $20. Review its latest run before evaluating usage. Absence of events is not proof of zero traffic: check workspace ingestion caps and workflow health.

Day 37: expand only when a service has at least 100 successful external calls, five approximate caller groups, two groups returning on three days, and at least 95% success among valid admitted calls. Listing delays, outages and telemetry gaps make results inconclusive.
